name: cline-openroute-template
description: Template para projetos Cline com resiliência OpenRoute (rate limiting, cache, compressão, fallback)

scripts.test:rate-limit: node -e "const {OpenRouteRateLimiter} = require('./src/rate-limiter'); const l = new OpenRouteRateLimiter(); console.log('Rate limiter OK');"
scripts.test:cache: node -e "const {TTLCache} = require('./src/cache'); const c = new TTLCache(); console.log('Cache OK');"
